mergedParams.userDescription: Geometric shape mask reveal. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Geometric Shape Mask Reveal with Internal Effects

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset that generates geometric polygon mask reveals using CSS clip-path animations. The effect should accept parameters for shape type (triangle, pentagon, hexagon, octagon), reveal direction (center-out, diagonal, spiral), and timing configuration. Implement multiple AnimationRange keyframes that animate clip-path polygon points from the shape's center outward, creating a geometric iris wipe effect. The effect should support both reveal and conceal modes, with customizable easing curves for organic motion. Include rotation animation on the clip-path itself for dynamic spiral reveals. The preset should return effects that can target any component ID, making it reusable for text blocks, video players, or image galleries.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[]. Properties animated: clipPath (polygon points), rotate, opacity. AnimationRange structure: Multiple keyframes with prog 0-1, animating polygon vertices from center (0% size) to full reveal (100% size). Effect data: { type: 'generic', start: params.start || 0, duration: params.duration || 1000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: ['polygon(...)', 'polygon(...)', 'polygon(...)'], prog: [0, 0.5, 1], easing: params.easing || 'ease-out' }] }. Input params schema: z.object({ shape: z.enum(['triangle', 'pentagon', 'hexagon', 'octagon']), direction: z.enum(['center-out', 'diagonal', 'spiral']), duration: z.number(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()), easing: z.string() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: [clipPathEffect, rotateEffect] }

prompts.prompt: Design an audio-reactive waveform effect preset that creates geometric shape pulsations synchronized to bass frequencies. The effect should generate scale and rotation transforms based on audio analysis, with shapes expanding and contracting to the beat. Implement threshold-based triggering that only activates on strong bass hits, creating punchy geometric reveals. Support multiple shape transformation modes: uniform scale, asymmetric stretch, and kaleidoscope rotation. The effect should layer multiple waveform properties (bass for scale, treble for rotation speed) to create complex, music-driven geometric animations. Include sensitivity controls for different music genres and intensity preferences.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Properties animated: scale, scaleX, scaleY, rotate. Waveform configuration: { type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 1.5, threshold: params.threshold || 0.6, smoothing: 0.1 }, { type: 'rotate', audioProperty: 'treble', sensitivity: 0.8, continuous: true }. Effect data: { type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: params.duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, waveformType: 'scale', props: { audioProperty: 'bass', minScale: 0, maxScale: params.maxScale || 1.5, threshold: 0.6 } }. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), duration: z.number(), sensitivity: z.number(), maxScale: z.number(), transformMode: z.enum(['uniform', 'stretch', 'kaleidoscope']) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { hooks: ['useWaveformData'] } }. Return: { effects: [scaleWaveformEffect, rotateWaveformEffect] }

prompts.prompt: Build a crystalline fracture mask effect that reveals content through animated geometric shards. The effect should generate multiple triangular clip-path regions that start as a shattered pattern and animate to form a complete reveal. Each shard should have independent timing offsets creating a cascading reconstruction effect. Implement parameters for shard count, fracture pattern (radial, linear, random), and stagger timing. Add subtle rotation and scale animations to individual shards for dimensional depth. The effect should support both constructive (pieces coming together) and destructive (breaking apart) modes, with customizable physics-based easing for realistic motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[] (combined). Properties animated: clipPath (multiple polygons), opacity, transform (scale + rotate). AnimationRange structure: Staggered keyframes for each shard, prog values offset by index * staggerAmount. Effect data: Multiple effects array, one per shard: { type: 'generic', start: baseStart + (index * params.stagger), duration: params.duration / 2, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [params.targetIds[index]], ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: [initialPolygon, finalPolygon], prog: [0, 1], easing: 'spring' }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 1], prog: [0, 0.3] }] }. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), shardCount: z.number().min(3).max(20), pattern: z.enum(['radial', 'linear', 'random']), stagger: z.number(), duration: z.number(), mode: z.enum(['construct', 'destruct']) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: [...shardEffects] }

prompts.prompt: Create a hexagonal honeycomb transition effect that masks content with animated hexagon cells. The effect should generate a grid of hexagonal clip-paths that reveal or conceal content in a wave pattern. Implement propagation algorithms that trigger hexagons based on distance from origin point (center, corner, edge, or custom coordinates). Each hexagon should scale and rotate during its reveal, creating a blooming effect. Support parameters for grid density, propagation speed, and wave direction. Add color overlay capabilities where each hexagon can have a brief color flash during transition. The effect should handle both regular and irregular hexagon patterns for organic variations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[] (multi-target). Properties animated: clipPath (hexagon points), scale, rotate, backgroundColor. AnimationRange structure: Wave-based timing, each hexagon's start time calculated by distance from origin. Effect data: { type: 'generic', start: calculateWaveDelay(row, col, params.origin), duration: params.cellDuration || 400, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`hex-${row}-${col}`], ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: ['polygon(50% 50%, 50% 50%, ...)', 'polygon(actual hex points)'], prog: [0, 1], easing: 'ease-out' }, { key: 'scale', val: [0, 1.1, 1], prog: [0, 0.7, 1] }] }. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), gridSize: z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()]), origin: z.enum(['center', 'topLeft', 'bottomRight', 'custom']), originCoords: z.optional(z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()])), propagationSpeed: z.number(), cellDuration: z.number(), colorFlash: z.optional(z.string()) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: hexagonEffectsArray }

prompts.prompt: Develop a diamond lattice reveal effect that uses overlapping rhombus shapes to create intricate geometric patterns during content transitions. The effect should animate multiple diamond-shaped clip-paths that interweave and rotate, forming a crystalline lattice structure. Implement offset patterns where diamonds alternate between foreground and background layers, creating depth through overlapping animations. Support parameters for lattice complexity, diamond aspect ratio, and rotation patterns. Each diamond should have phase-shifted animations creating mesmerizing kaleidoscope effects. Include opacity gradients that fade from the pattern's center to edges for smooth blending.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[] (layered). Properties animated: clipPath (rhombus/diamond), rotate, opacity, zIndex. AnimationRange structure: Phase-shifted animations with sine wave modulation for organic motion. Effect data: { type: 'generic', start: params.start + (Math.sin(index * 0.5) * 200), duration: params.duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generateDiamondPath(index, phase), prog: [0, 0.4, 0.8, 1], easing: 'ease-in-out' }, { key: 'rotate', val: [0, 45, -45, 0], prog: [0, 0.33, 0.66, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 1, 1, 0], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.8, 1] }] }. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), latticeSize: z.number().min(2).max(10), diamondRatio: z.number(), rotationAmplitude: z.number(), duration: z.number(), layerCount: z.number().min(1).max(3), phaseShift: z.number() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: diamondLatticeEffects }

prompts.prompt: Engineer an audio-reactive geometric kaleidoscope effect that creates symmetrical shape patterns responding to music frequencies. The effect should generate mirrored triangular segments that rotate and scale based on different frequency bands - bass controls overall scale, mids affect rotation speed, and treble influences color shifts. Implement fractal-like behavior where shapes spawn smaller copies at beat peaks, creating recursive geometric patterns. Support parameters for symmetry count (3-fold to 12-fold), recursion depth, and frequency mapping. Each symmetrical segment should have independent waveform responses while maintaining overall pattern coherence. Include strobe-like opacity pulses synchronized to kick drums for dynamic reveals.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (multi-frequency). Properties animated: scale, rotate, opacity, hue-rotate filter. Waveform configuration: Multiple audio properties mapped to different transforms. Effect data: Array of waveform effects: [{ type: 'waveform', waveformType: 'scale', props: { audioProperty: 'bass', minScale: 0.5, maxScale: params.maxScale || 2, sensitivity: 1.2 } }, { type: 'waveform', waveformType: 'rotate', props: { audioProperty: 'mid', continuous: true, speed: params.rotationSpeed || 1 } }, { type: 'waveform', waveformType: 'custom', props: { audioProperty: 'treble', customTransform: 'hue-rotate', minValue: 0, maxValue: 360 } }]. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), symmetryFold: z.number().min(3).max(12), recursionDepth: z.number().min(1).max(3), maxScale: z.number(), rotationSpeed: z.number(), frequencyMapping: z.object({ bass: z.enum(['scale', 'opacity']), mid: z.enum(['rotate', 'blur']), treble: z.enum(['color', 'brightness']) }), strobeSensitivity: z.number() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { hooks: ['useWaveformData'] } }. Return: { effects: kaleidoscopeWaveformEffects }

prompts.prompt: Design a prismatic refraction effect that reveals content through animated triangular prisms that split and refract like light through glass. The effect should create RGB color separation as triangular masks slide across content, simulating chromatic aberration. Implement multiple prism layers with different angles and refraction indices, creating rainbow-like reveals. Each prism should have offset color channels (red, green, blue) that converge during animation. Support parameters for prism count, refraction intensity, and color separation distance. Add glass-like properties including subtle blur gradients and brightness variations along prism edges for realistic optical effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[] (RGB split). Properties animated: clipPath (triangular), transform (translateX/Y for RGB channels), filter (blur, brightness), mix-blend-mode. AnimationRange structure: Separate animations for R, G, B channel offsets. Effect data: Three effects per prism (one per color channel): { type: 'generic', start: params.start, duration: params.duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`${baseId}-red`, `${baseId}-green`, `${baseId}-blue`], ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generatePrismPath(angle, position), prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'translateX', val: [channelOffset * 20, 0], prog: [0, 1], easing: 'ease-out' }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0.33, 1], prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: ['blur(2px) brightness(1.2)', 'blur(0px) brightness(1)'], prog: [0, 1] }] }. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), prismCount: z.number(), refractionIndex: z.number().min(1).max(3), colorSeparation: z.number(), duration: z.number(), angleVariation: z.number(), edgeBlur: z.boolean() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: [...prismRGBEffects] }

prompts.prompt: Build a tessellation morph effect that transforms between different geometric patterns - triangles morphing to squares to hexagons. The effect should smoothly animate clip-path vertices to transition between tessellation patterns, creating fluid geometric transformations. Implement intelligent vertex mapping that maintains smooth transitions even when polygon vertex counts differ. Support parameters for pattern sequence, morph duration, and intermediate states. Each tile in the tessellation should have micro-delays creating ripple effects across the pattern. Include scaling oscillations during morphs to add dimensional pop. The effect should handle both uniform tessellations and Penrose-style aperiodic patterns.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[] (vertex morph). Properties animated: clipPath (dynamic vertex count), scale, rotate. AnimationRange structure: Multi-step morphing with intelligent vertex interpolation. Effect data: { type: 'generic', start: params.start + (tileIndex * params.rippleDelay), duration: params.morphDuration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generateMorphSequence(params.patterns), prog: generateProgressSteps(params.patterns.length), easing: 'ease-in-out' }, { key: 'scale', val: [1, 0.9, 1.1, 1], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }] }. Vertex interpolation: Smart algorithm to add/remove vertices for smooth transitions. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), patterns: z.array(z.enum(['triangle', 'square', 'pentagon', 'hexagon', 'octagon'])), morphDuration: z.number(), rippleDelay: z.number(), tileSize: z.number(), oscillationAmplitude: z.number(), tessellationType: z.enum(['regular', 'semi-regular', 'penrose']) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: tessellationMorphEffects }

prompts.prompt: Create a geometric portal effect that reveals content through expanding polygonal apertures with sci-fi energy field aesthetics. The effect should animate concentric polygonal rings that expand from center, each with different rotation speeds and glow intensities. Implement electric arc effects along polygon edges using animated box-shadows and filters. Support parameters for portal shape (pentagon, hexagon, octagon), ring count, and energy color. Each ring should have phase-shifted animations creating a tunnel-like depth effect. Include particle-like elements at vertices that flare during expansion. The effect should combine multiple visual layers: the mask itself, glow effects, and optional distortion ripples.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[] (composite). Properties animated: clipPath (expanding polygons), boxShadow (glow), filter (blur + brightness), transform (scale + rotate). AnimationRange structure: Concentric rings with staggered timing. Effect data: Multiple effects per ring: { type: 'generic', start: params.start + (ringIndex * 100), duration: params.duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`portal-ring-${ringIndex}`], ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generateConcentricPolygon(ringIndex, params.shape), prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'boxShadow', val: [`0 0 0px ${params.glowColor}`, `0 0 ${20 + ringIndex * 10}px ${params.glowColor}`], prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: [`brightness(2) blur(${ringIndex}px)`, 'brightness(1) blur(0px)'], prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'rotate', val: [0, 360 * (ringIndex % 2 ? 1 : -1)], prog: [0, 1] }] }. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), portalShape: z.enum(['pentagon', 'hexagon', 'octagon']), ringCount: z.number().min(2).max(6), duration: z.number(), glowColor: z.string(), glowIntensity: z.number(), rotationSpeed: z.number(), distortionEnabled: z.boolean() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: [...portalRingEffects, ...glowEffects, ...particleEffects] }

prompts.prompt: Develop a crystallization freeze effect that gradually converts content into geometric crystal formations. The effect should start with organic shapes that progressively become more angular and geometric, simulating a freezing or crystallization process. Implement vertex multiplication where smooth curves subdivide into faceted surfaces over time. Support parameters for crystal type (quartz, cubic, prismatic), crystallization speed, and fractal complexity. Each crystal facet should have independent shimmer animations using brightness and hue variations. Include frost spread patterns where crystallization propagates from seed points. The effect should layer multiple geometric overlays creating complex prismatic structures with depth and refraction effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic AnimationRange[] (progressive subdivision). Properties animated: clipPath (vertex multiplication), filter (brightness, hue-rotate, contrast), opacity, transform. AnimationRange structure: Progressive complexity increase through vertex interpolation. Effect data: { type: 'generic', start: params.start, duration: params.duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'clipPath', val: generateCrystallizationSequence(params.subdivisions), prog: generateSubdivisionProgress(params.subdivisions), easing: 'ease-out' }, { key: 'filter', val: ['brightness(1) saturate(1)', 'brightness(1.3) saturate(0.5) hue-rotate(180deg)'], prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'backdropFilter', val: ['blur(0px)', `blur(${params.refractionBlur}px)`], prog: [0.5, 1] }] }. Subdivision algorithm: Catmull-Clark or Loop subdivision adapted for 2D. Input params schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), crystalType: z.enum(['quartz', 'cubic', 'prismatic', 'dendritic']), subdivisions: z.number().min(1).max(5), duration: z.number(), seedPoints: z.array(z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()])), propagationSpeed: z.number(), shimmerIntensity: z.number(), refractionBlur: z.number(), frostOpacity: z.number() }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: [...crystallizationEffects, ...shimmerEffects, ...frostOverlayEffects] }
